'''Stu Doran OS Goes Crazy (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Stu Doran]] posted on DeckTech on 4 October 2001 about [[October 2001 tournament (Stu Doran)]].<ref name="tr-d3018">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-04-os-goes-crazyd3018/ os-goes-crazy], DeckTech (Stu "Disco Stu" Doran, 4 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-04-os-goes-crazyd3018/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Stu Doran played a two-player event at a place he calls 'OS', reported in October 2001, with WYS and Hunt Down against Podracing Profit and Watto decks; the report gives no results.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Stu Doran]] (byline: Stu "Disco Stu" Doran)
* '''Published:''' 4 October 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''OS Goes Crazy''
* '''Event:''' [[October 2001 tournament (Stu Doran)]]
* '''Event date:''' October 2001
* '''Players:''' 2
* '''Light deck:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]]
* '''Dark deck:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Huntdown]]
